title: Blue orchids
lyrics_synced:
[00:23.50] I dreamed of two blue orchids
[00:27.50] Two beautiful blue orchids
[00:31.00] One night, while in my lonely room
[00:39.50] I dreamed of two blue orchids
[00:43.50] So full of love and light
[00:47.50] That I wanted to possess each tender bloom
[00:56.00] Then my dream took wings
[00:59.50] And through a thousand springs
[01:03.50] Blue orchids seemed in a world apart
[01:12.00] But when I met you
[01:15.00] Something pale and blue
[01:19.50] Came stealing from the meadows of my heart
[01:27.50] I saw my two blue orchids
[01:31.50] My beautiful blue orchids
[01:35.00] Last night, and what a sweet surprise
[01:44.00] When you looked at me
[01:48.00] It was plain to see
[01:51.50] Blue orchids only bloom in your eyes.
